name: Zhanghua City

queries.query: Zhanghua City Taiwan official cadastral parcel map GIS land registration service
queries.result: Official-source discovery identified the National Land Surveying and Mapping Center (NLSC) public cadastral viewer, the national land-service/e-transcript service, and the Changhua Land Office official portal. The NLSC viewer's current JavaScript documents an anonymous cadastral overlay request, but the bounded exact-point request produced no parcel geometry.

source.name: National Land Surveying and Mapping Center cadastral viewer; Changhua Land Office official portal

source.operatorNote: The current viewer JavaScript identifies https://landmaps.nlsc.gov.tw/S_Maps/qryTileMapIndex with flag=1 (city plus projected X/Y) for cadastral overlay images. No owner, address, title, tax, account, or personal fields were requested.

requests.result: Viewer HTML and current JavaScript/configuration retrieved; CRS/endpoint logic inspected.
Official local custodian page retrieved; links to NLSC, e-transcript and Changhua land-information services recorded.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; exact unchanged WUP point transformed to EPSG:3826 for the viewer request
requests.assessment: This is a bounded query response, not evidence of citywide absence; no geometry or parcel ID retained.

requests.result: Empty response body after bounded timeout window; no location or parcel result inferred.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official NLSC cadastral viewer, national land-service material, and Changhua local land-office portal were reviewed.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public viewer route and request schema were verified, but no anonymous parcel polygon/native ID was obtained at the unchanged WUP point; citywide coverage is unknown.

technicalBlocker: The documented NLSC cadastral overlay request returned only a no-land-number message for the exact point, and the location query returned an empty body. The public viewer is reference-only and does not expose a verified full-polygon response in this pass.
remainingUncertainty: The viewer may require a parcel-number or map interaction route, and the local Changhua full-service system may have access controls or undocumented APIs. A zero exact-point response is not treated as citywide absence.
nextStep: Serial reviewer may independently qualify the NLSC/local Changhua service if a safe anonymous parcel geometry response can be obtained without login or unsafe fields.
pointBasis: Exact unchanged UN WUP 2025 settlement point (latitude, longitude); not shifted to force a parcel hit.
